scenes.on_screen_text: Number Series: Arithmetic Progression (AP) formula: a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d, Geometric Progression (GP) formula: a_n = a_1 * r^(n-1)

scenes.on_screen_text: Coding-Decoding: Substitution Cipher Formula: E(x) = (x + n) mod 26
